KVBC Wednesday Slow Roll

Topeka, KS · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

KVBC Wednesday Slow Roll is a social group ride in Topeka, KS. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:10 pm from Washburn University parking lot, SW 20th & MacVicar. About 15 miles, no drop, lycra optional. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:10 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no drop, lycra optional. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @kawvalleybicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the KVBC Wednesday Slow Roll group ride

A 15-mile round trip on streets and trails for beginner and intermediate riders. E-bikes welcome. Often stops for ice cream near the end. Helmets and a good attitude required. Check the club's calendar or Facebook for start and end dates.
